verdict.rationale: Unit is banking-as-a-service infrastructure: accounts, payments, cards and lending exposed through APIs and a dashboard. It is not an AI agent or host that consumes external tools, so plugging MCP servers in as a client is a category error for this product type. Nothing in the evidence shows Unit has an agent or assistant that could act as an MCP client.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
